    LargeIndecomposable.piece_preprojCompNode

    Pieces have preprojective components in the node setting #

    For a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra with torsion-free fundamental group, every nonempty convex finite piece of the universal cover has a preprojective component (piece_preprojCompNode). This combines acyclicity (coverAcyclicNode), interval-finiteness (hullNode) and local simple connectivity (coverLocalSCNode) of the cover with piece_preprojComp.
